site_watch.name: Website watcher
site_watch.desc: Checks whether websites are reachable and whether their content changed.
site_watch.help: Save addresses you want to keep an eye on: your own site, a product, an announcement. Each check shows the HTTP status and response time and whether the visible text changed since last time (scripts, ads in the HTML code and whitespace do not count). Optionally give a text that must be on the page, for example "In stock". Only a fingerprint is stored, not the page itself.
site_watch.first_check: First check, changes are detected from now on.
site_watch.ask_text: Text that must be on the page (Enter = none):
